summary: Records how the committees that select, confirm, and recall members of the IAB and IESG operate, collecting lessons that had been passed on only orally. It was replaced by RFC 2282.

eli5.summary: It is a handbook for the people who pick the leaders. Past picking committees wrote down their tips so new ones do not start from zero.
